### [`v0.17.8`](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/releases/tag/v0.17.8)

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.17.8 -->

#### What's Changed

##### ✨ Enhancements

- Prevent gems from calling `exit` or `abort` during gem load by [@​paracycle](https://redirect.github.com/paracycle) in [#​2387](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2387)
- Print currently compiling gems. Add verbose attribute to gem command. by [@​cub8](https://redirect.github.com/cub8) in [#​2395](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2395)

##### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Generate Active Model attributes in an included `GeneratedAttributeMethods` module by [@​paracycle](https://redirect.github.com/paracycle) in [#​2356](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2356)
- Fix RBS comment prefix in YardDoc listener by [@​KaanOzkan](https://redirect.github.com/KaanOzkan) in [#​2364](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2364)
- Fix rbi deleted when route\_dsl runs on files affected by other compilers by [@​domingo2000](https://redirect.github.com/domingo2000) in [#​2358](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2358)
- Use `Bundler.load.specs` instead of reading `Gemfile.lock` by [@​KaanOzkan](https://redirect.github.com/KaanOzkan) in [#​2363](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2363)
- Sort YARD comments that have the same tag name by [@​KaanOzkan](https://redirect.github.com/KaanOzkan) in [#​2375](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2375)
- use ActiveRecordColumnTypeHelper for primary key types by [@​bobcats](https://redirect.github.com/bobcats) in [#​2377](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2377)
- Do not mixin Kernel for modules by [@​KaanOzkan](https://redirect.github.com/KaanOzkan) in [#​2394](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2394)

#### New Contributors

- [@​domingo2000](https://redirect.github.com/domingo2000) made their first contribution in [#​2358](https://redirect.github.com/Shopify/tapioca/pull/2358)
